summary: STMicroelectronics N.V. filed a Form 6-K containing a press release announcing the appointment of Mr. Armando Varricchio as Chairman and Mr. Nicolas Dufourcq as Vice-Chairman of the Supervisory Board for a 3-year term following the Annual General Meeting of Shareholders. No special situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes are involved. The filing is a routine report of foreign private issuer regarding standard board appointments after an ordinary shareholder meeting, not a forced or abrupt departure. No deal terms apply.
